```{r}
f1 <- function(x){
  1-x^3
}

f2 <- function(x){
(1 - x)^(1/3)
}

fixed_point <- function(g, initial, tol = 1e-6, max_iter = 1000) {
  x <- initial
  
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    x_new <- g(x)
    
    if (abs(x_new - x) < tol) {
      cat("The root converges.\n")
      return(list(status = "converges", root = x_new))
    }
    
    x <- x_new
  }
  
  cat("The root diverges.\n")
  return(list(status = "diverges", root = NULL))
}
```

```{r}
run <- function() {
  formula <- readline("Enter a function of x: ")
  g <- parse(text = formula)[[1]]
  initial <- as.numeric(readline("Enter initial value: "))

  result <- fixed_point(
    function(x) eval(g, envir = list(x = x)),
    initial
  )
  print(result)
}
```
